description: Find a value in an install's kept runs: the first step of removing something that must not stay (a person's email, an order number). The server decrypts the newest runs in the window and walks every JSON leaf; a string or number whose text contains the value matches, case-insensitively. Returns each matching run with the JSON Pointer paths that held it, so a redaction can name exactly those paths. At most 2,000 runs are scanned per call; truncated true with scannedThrough says where it stopped, so narrow the window with since and until. Already-redacted leaves never match. The owner or a member of the install searches it; an install key cannot.

since.description: ISO 8601: runs archived at or after this instant.

until.description: ISO 8601: runs archived at or before this instant.

value.description: The text to find, 2 to 200 characters.

name: find_locker_runs
title: Find locker runs
